name: Formul Plastik A.S.
summary: Formul Plastik A.S. designs, manufactures, and sells pipes and fittings in Turkey and internationally. The company offers PP-R pipes and fittings, PPRCT pipes, PVC pipes and fittings, silent PP pipes and fittings, PE-RT pipes, and accessories, as well as brass inserts and fittings. Formul Plastik A.S. was founded in 1990 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
